intro: Winter's Presents is an invitation extended to adventurers in Orgrimmar during the Feast of Winter Veil. Guided by holiday organizers and goblin apparatus tenders, Horde heroes are directed to visit Great-father Winter beneath the decorated festive tree to claim gifts prepared for them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I hear Great-father Winter - with the generous support of Smokeywood Pastures - has put presents for everyone under the tree in Orgrimmar. I wish I could go, but I've got to look after the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt.
But you should definitely check it out. I'm sure Great-father Winter has some presents with your name on them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, ho hello there! You can only be here for one reason: to open your Winter Veil presents.
Now, don't you worry, Great-father Winter hasn't forgotten about his favorite traveler adventurer. Look under the tree and you'll find your gifts.
During this season of giving, perhaps your friends would also enjoy receiving some of Smokeywood Pasture's excellent products?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
